Eligibility Criteria :

Are you an undergraduate student looking for Science and Engineering Internships? The DAAD RISE Internship is the perfect opportunity for you. Go through the eligibility criteria of this international internship before applying. 

RISE Summer Internship 2027 in Germany Requirements: 

  • Applicants must be undergraduate students and should be done with at least two years of their degree by the time of the Research Internships in Science and Engineering (RISE). 
  • They should be enrolled in fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, physics, earth sciences, engineering, or related fields. 
  • Moreover, interns must be studying at accredited universities or colleges in North America, Ireland or Britain to be eligible for the RISE internship. International students must prove that they have studied at a university or college in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, or Ireland for more than 12 months by the application deadline. 
  • Applicants must maintain their undergraduate status after completing the internship. German citizens can apply only if they can prove that they have lived outside Germany for at least six years and include the relevant information in their CV. 
  • Knowledge of the German language is not essential since the working language will be English. However, it can be helpful in everyday life. 
  • Applicants must meet any additional criteria. Recent graduates can explore the RISE Professional program.
